tdd_result.description: Implement Codex header-based independent quota windows

data.status: delivered — implementation complete, all automated coverage green; one upstream host gap discovered and reported (not patched)
behavior_delivered: New business module extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/codex-quota.ts: one process-wide set of Codex allowance windows, fed by two sources through ONE business parser (the API document and the x-codex-* headers are each reduced to the same ReportedWindow, then read by the same windowsOf/chosenWindow/apply).
Windows identified by reported length (±5% of 5h / 7d), never by primary/secondary; closest length wins, equal distance keeps the receipt order.
Valid single window updates independently; a window a batch does not carry keeps its value AND its obtainedAt; a window no source ever reported is unavailable, never zero.

startup(): exactly one account API query per instance, awaited from the instance's initialization — business-held address https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage, business-prepared headers (Authorization: Bearer <credential> plus chatgpt-account-id read from the credential's own JWT claim), 10000ms business budget, shared configuration's named `codex` proxy, never the inference base URL. A refused selection is classified `misconfigured` and never turned into a direct connection; no TTL, retry, polling, fallback or switch query exists at runtime.
headersReceived(): one response's headers as one batch, applied in receipt order; a batch identifying no window changes nothing and notifies nobody.
resetStateOf(): valid/expired/invalid/unknown read at read time from the instant the window already carries, never written back, no cross-source time ordering.

criteria_evidence.criterion: 初始化 API 和响应 headers 使用同一业务 parser，API 仅启动使用；初始化选命名 codex 代理、10000ms 业务预算，地址/headers 由业务持有，不借推理 base URL
